sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads the animation wrapper, the section label, the mode setting, and the text data this section needs. It also marks the file as browser-side code.

sections.name: About
sections.title: The About section
sections.what: Builds the About block: a biography that changes with the mode, location and education facts, and a line about current work. Switching modes fades the biography back in.
sections.why: Likely reason: a side column for facts and a wider column for the biography keeps the page easy to scan.
sections.watch_out: The headline is always the first item of the mode's biography list, so reordering that list changes the heading.

summary: The About section of the home page: a short biography that switches between calm and nerd wording, plus where I am based, my education, and what I am doing right now.
purpose: Introduces the owner of the site to visitors on the home page.
why: Keeps the biography text in the data files and lets it change with the calm or nerd mode.
how: Reads the current mode, picks the matching biography, shows its first item as a large headline and the rest as body paragraphs, then fills the location, education, and current focus from the site data.
inputs: The current mode from the mode context, plus the intro and site data files.
outputs: A page section with a headline, body paragraphs, a small facts list, and a Right now line.
risks: If the biography list for the current mode is empty, there is no headline to show. The site facts are shown exactly as given, with no fallback text.
debug: If the About text is wrong, check the intro and site data files. If the text does not change when the mode is toggled, check the mode provider and the mode wrapper in this file.
